method: Mermaid edges parsed from output/diagram/diagrams/*.mmd; nodes bound to source IDs through diagrams_artifact node_sources. Process-flow paragraph-to-paragraph edges are derived through decision/rule nodes and compared with structural Java PERFORM edges or fall-through to the next paragraph. Component/sequence program-to-program edges are compared with Java CALLs and CICS/external boundary gaps. No equivalence is claimed from names or layout.
